collection.description: Old friends reunite at a garden they planted years earlier.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Old friends reunite at a garden they planted years earlier.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They admire how much has grown.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They find that some favorite flowers have disappeared.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The friends begin a fresh shared project.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They decide to tend existing plants instead.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Children hear stories of the old friendship.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The children are more interested in butterflies.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The friends sit together without needing conversation.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One admits they missed the other more than expected.
